Calculator.title: Emissions Calculator & Offset Payment
Calculator.subtitle: Calculation & Compliance
Calculator.input_desc: Enter institutional activity data for precise calculation.
Calculator.validation_desc: Input values fall within expected ranges for the selected region. Emission factor: {factor} kg CO2e/L.
Calculator.calc_method_desc: Emissions are calculated using the Tier 2 approach as defined by the IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, utilizing country-specific emission factors where available.
Calculator.compliance_desc: State institutions are required to offset at least 40% of Scope 1 emissions quarterly. Failure to comply may result in budget allocation penalties under the Green Governance Act 2023.
Calculator.full_offset_desc: Complete neutralization. Includes Gold Standard Certificate.

CarbonTax.rates_subtitle: Reference rates applicable to maritime traffic under international law and the Africgreen Sovereign Framework.
CarbonTax.vessels_subtitle: Current compliance status of all vessels within the Somaliland Exclusive Economic Zone.
CarbonTax.revenue_subtitle: Monthly revenue breakdown by vessel type over the last 12 months.

Africgreen operates under the Somaliland Sovereign Environmental Framework and recognizes all applicable international conventions. CarbonCredit.hero_subtitle: Track Somaliland's sovereign carbon credit issuance, monitor voluntary market benchmarks (VCS, Gold Standard, ICVCM/CCP, ACMI, Paris Art. 6), and manage the territorial project pipeline.
CarbonCredit.market_subtitle: Reference prices per tCO₂ across major certification standards. Data sourced from MSCI Global Carbon Credit Price Index, Regreener.earth, and carboncredits.com (2024–2025).
CarbonCredit.market_disclaimer: Market prices are indicative averages as of Q1 2025 and may vary significantly by project quality, vintage, co-benefits, and buyer requirements. Africgreen Sovereign Credits are not listed on public exchanges.
CarbonCredit.projects_subtitle: Sovereign and internationally certified carbon offset projects in Somaliland — reforestation, mangrove restoration, blue carbon, and clean cooking initiatives.
CarbonCredit.portfolio_subtitle: 12-month evolution of carbon credit issuance, retirement, and available inventory across all Somaliland sovereign projects.
CarbonCredit.framework_subtitle: Overview of international mechanisms governing carbon credit integrity, certification, and cross-border trading applicable to Africgreen sovereign projects.
CarbonCredit.framework_disclaimer: This framework overview is for informational purposes only. Africgreen aligns sovereign carbon credits with Paris Agreement Article 6.2 and ACMI eligibility criteria. Project operators should consult their designated national focal point and verification body (VVB) for definitive certification requirements.
